        <data source="start date"><label>Start date</label></data>
        <data source="end date"><label>End date</label></data>
        <data source="toy type"><label>Toy type</label></data>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>	
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:ToyLine|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
